sn35.140:1.2: yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
sn35.140:1.3: aniccasambhūtaṃ bhikkhave cakkhuṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.140:1.5: yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya sopi anicco.
sn35.140:1.6: aniccasambhūtā bhikkhave, jivhā kuto niccā bhavissati. kāyo …pe…
sn35.140:1.8: yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
sn35.140:1.9: aniccasambhūto bhikkhave, mano kuto nicco bhavissati.
sn35.140:1.10: evaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, sotasmimpi …pe… ghānasmimpi …pe… jivhāyapi …pe… kāyasmimpi …pe… manasmimpi nibbindati,
sn35.140:1.11: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.140:1.12: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
